info.name: SAP Crystal Reports RESTful Web Services Authentication OData API
Crystal Reports Get OData Service Document

params.name: reportId
params.description: Infostore object ID of the Crystal Report

items.docs: Returns the OData service document listing available collections (Rows and GrandTotals) for the specified report.

info.name: Crystal Reports Get EDMX Metadata Document

params.name: reportId
params.description: Infostore object ID of the Crystal Report

items.docs: Returns the OData EDMX metadata document describing the entity types, properties, and associations for the report data service.

info.name: Crystal Reports Get Report Data Rows

params.name: reportId
params.description: Infostore object ID of the Crystal Report

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of rows to skip

params.name: $skiptoken
params.description: Token for server-driven paging

params.name: $inlinecount
params.description: Include total count in response

params.name: $count
params.description: Return only the count of rows

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include

items.docs: Returns report data rows via OData. Supports paging with $skip and $skiptoken, row counting with $inlinecount and $count, field selection with $select, and parameter filtering.

info.name: Crystal Reports Push a Row of Data to Transient Instance

params.name: reportId
params.description: Infostore object ID of the Crystal Report

items.docs: Pushes a row of data to a transient report instance for data-driven report generation.

info.name: Crystal Reports Get Specific Row by Index

params.name: reportId
params.description: Infostore object ID of the Crystal Report

params.name: index
params.description: Zero-based index of the row

items.docs: Returns a single report data row identified by its zero-based index within the Rows collection.

info.name: Crystal Reports Get Specific Field from Row

params.name: reportId
params.description: Infostore object ID of the Crystal Report

params.name: index
params.description: Zero-based index of the row

params.name: fieldName
params.description: Name of the field to retrieve

items.docs: Returns the value of a specific field from a report data row, wrapped in OData format.

info.name: Crystal Reports Get Raw Field Value

params.name: reportId
params.description: Infostore object ID of the Crystal Report

params.name: index
params.description: Zero-based index of the row

params.name: fieldName
params.description: Name of the field to retrieve

items.docs: Returns the raw, unwrapped value of a specific field from a report data row as plain text.

params.name: reportId
params.description: Infostore object ID of the Crystal Report

items.docs: Returns the grand total summary fields for the report data, including aggregated values across all rows.

params.name: reportId
params.description: Infostore object ID of the Crystal Report

params.name: GroupName
params.description: Name of the group collection

items.docs: Returns data for a specific group within the report. Group names correspond to the group conditions defined in the report structure.

info.name: Crystal Reports Get Specific Group by Path

params.name: reportId
params.description: Infostore object ID of the Crystal Report

params.name: GroupName
params.description: Name of the group collection

params.name: groupPath
params.description: Path identifier for the specific group entry

items.docs: Returns data for a specific group entry identified by its group path string within the named group collection.
